1141892292.description:
You're more predictable than you think.

Ask anyone to be random and they fall into habits: avoiding repeats, switching after a loss, leaning on a favorite throw. Mind Reader+ is rock-paper-scissors against an AI that studies every throw you make and predicts your next one. Beat it, and you've learned how you think. Then turn the tables and learn to read others.

THE READER: AN AI THAT READS YOU
• Seven pattern-spotting strategies watch your throws, each tried at three levels of second-guessing. The AI follows whichever one is reading you best right now.
• It locks in its throw before you choose and never peeks. Tap "Prove it" to write your throw down first and check for yourself.
• After each round, see what it predicted, how sure it was, and why.
• If it can't read you, it throws truly at random: the only move that can't be exploited.

KNOW YOUR PATTERN
• Your Unpredictability score shows how often the AI calls your throw, compared with pure chance.
• Track it set by set, and see your throw mix and how you react after a win, a loss or a tie.
• Find your tells: the habits that give you away, ranked by how strongly they show.
• Ask Claude for a coaching read: your patterns, how an opponent would exploit them, drills to break them, and how the same habits show up at the negotiating table.

READ THE BOT
The roles flip. Each bot has one hidden habit, buried in noise, just like real people. Spot it, exploit it, then name it. Six bots to crack: The Rock, Copycat, The Cycler, Sore Loser, Counter-Puncher and Restless.

WHY ROCK-PAPER-SCISSORS?
RPS is gaming at its most basic. Take anything away and it stops being a game; every other game, at some level, contains it. The rules are simple, but the game is as complex as the mind of your opponent. What it trains, noticing patterns and hiding your own, carries over to cards, sports, sales and negotiation.

• Plays on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo
• Sound, haptics and a fast-play mode
• No account. Your history stays on your device; Claude sees only a compact summary of your games, and only when you ask for a read.

Description:-
This app is designed specifically for the visually impaired but anybody can use it as a simple way of finding your current location. The approach is an easy to use interface, with only a few big buttons, swipe gestures and shaking of the iDevice. The main 2 unique features are that it has speech built in and with a simple ‘double tap’ on the main screen, it tells you the road or street you are in. If you are near a property, it also says the house number. The help instructions are ‘audible’ so no need to read text or use VoiceOver if you want help, just shake your iDevice.

It displays and says 4 pieces of information:-
The house number and road / street.
The postcode / zip code.
The town name.
The What3Words system for your location.

On the second screen it displays a map of the area you are in but zoomed into a small area, so that you could get help form a sighted person for directions. As you move the view updates and speaks the road you are in, if you pass a junction it also says that road name. If you are traveling on a bus this process can be useful to indicate when you’re nearing where you want to alight.

The data entry screen is to type / paste either “What 3 Words” or a “latitude & longitude” values and view the information on the main screen. To access the screen, just do a very long touch anywhere on the main screen white area.

Basic method of use:-
1/ When you start the app it gathers 4 details of your location and displays them on the screen.
2/ Using either the large blue ‘Refresh Button’ or a one finger ‘double tap’ anywhere on the screen and it speaks the road name of your location.
3/ If you ‘double tap’ with two fingers, it reads out all 4 lines of information.
4/ If you touch and hold any of the 4 light blue text boxes it copies the displayed text to your clipboard which you send to a friend.
5/ If you touch and hold the large ‘Refresh Button’ it prepares an email with all your current location details. When the email appears you can add the address of the person you want to send it to.
6/ In Map screen if you Double Tap with 4 fingers this disable both buttons and turns them red, repeat operation to reverse status. This is useful if you put your iPhone in a pocket to hear the speech and don’t want to accidentally action either button.
6/ If you need help using the app there is a button bottom right that ‘speaks’ the instructions.

Loc button:-
The ‘Loc’ button at the bottom of screen does two things. It speaks the latitude & longitude and then copies this information to the clipboard. 

Swipe Gestures:-
1/ To view the map, just swipe horizontally either from Left to Right or Right to Left.
2/ Swiping Up with 2 fingers speeds up the speech and Down slows it down. These rates of speech are remembered when you open the app.

Shake Gesture:-
In Main or Map screens, a quick shake to hear your current location.


Compatibility:-
Where Am I is Universal and compatible with any iPad that can access the internet, iPhone 4s, to any of the latest iPhone’s.

Requires iOS 8.2 or later.

6757317342.description:
Cleaning your whole house on the weekend sucks.

You block off Sunday afternoon, haul out the supplies, go room by room — and two hours later you're done. Until something actually fun comes up. Then cleaning gets skipped. The mess compounds. And now you need even more time to dig out from under it.

There's a better way.

CleanStreak gives you one five-minute task to knock out every day. It guides you around your home room by room, working through each of the four Pillars of Clean. When you've made it through every room, you start over. Your home stays clean — not because you had a free weekend, but because small steps add up.

How it works

Every room has three elements of clean:
• Windows, frames, and wall fixtures — probably the most overlooked part of any room, but once you start noticing dusty sills and smudged glass, you can't unsee it.
• Surfaces wiped down — which sometimes means putting a few things away first. That's part of the deal.
• Floors vacuumed or swept — mopped ideally, but we're not asking for that every day.

CleanStreak works top to bottom: day one is windows, day two is surfaces, day three is floors. Then you move to the next room.
Every fourth day, instead of a room task, you get a hygienic touchpoint — the spots that need a little extra attention, like the kitchen sink or the shower.

Your streak
Each consecutive day you complete a task, you add to your streak. That's it. No psychological games pulling you back into the app, no owl shaming you for missing a day. Just a running count of days you showed up — and a noticeably cleaner home.

Build the habit
The goal isn't to clean your house. The goal is to make cleaning something you do without thinking — not out of guilt, not to dig yourself out of a hole, just habit. CleanStreak helps you get there one five-minute task at a time.

A cleaner home every day.

• Choose the apps you want a pause in front of: two for free, or any number and whole categories with Plus.
• Open one and you get a check-in: a mood from Low to Great, and what you are hoping to find.
• Unlock just that app for 5, 15 or 30 minutes.

INSIGHTS FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
• Which apps lift your mood and which drain it.

• How often you found what you came for.

GENTLE OR FIRM

• Firm: a daily budget you set in advance, no skipping, and one emergency pass a week.

KIND, NOT STRICT
Good Terms asks and reflects back. It never scolds, and every limit is one you set and can change.

A SKY THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
